descriptions.f1b_drain_list_service_8016636c: Repeatedly compare the sentinel at owner offset 28 with its first node; while unequal, invoke virtual byte slot 48 on the service at offset 20 with the first node's offset-40 pointer adjusted by four when nonnull, followed by zero. Re-read the list after each call and return zero when empty. Removal by the service is inferred.
